title: Tune monitoring alert thresholds
description:
Current alert configuration is generating excessive false positives, causing alert fatigue for the on-call team. The following alerts fire multiple times daily despite no actual service degradation:

- payment_error_rate: threshold 0.1% but baseline is ~0.3% (fires almost every hour)
- user_service_latency_p99: threshold 150ms but baseline is ~140ms (fires on normal variance)
- notification_delivery_time: threshold 200ms but baseline is ~180ms (fires during batch sends)
- memory_usage_payment: threshold 70% but baseline is ~65% (fires during GC cycles)

Need to analyze the last 7 days of error_rates_last_7d.csv data to establish proper baselines and set thresholds that catch genuine anomalies without alerting on normal operational noise.

Recommended approach: Set thresholds at baseline + 2 standard deviations for each metric.
scope: Adjust alert thresholds based on 7-day error rate analysis to reduce false positives
